info.title: My Hosting API
info.description: Cookie-authenticated same-origin API. Prefix every path with /hosting behind Workspace. Write requests require exact configured Origin plus X-CSRF-Token from /api/me; authentication/bootstrap use their dedicated controls. Trusted administrator preview. See OPERATIONS.md.
